authority_note: This file fixes which team-seasons the reconstruction reports on. It is not a ratified historical population and no Z score is computed over it. resolve_population returns UNRESOLVED for every season in scope precisely because this frame's source is not mounted.

derivation.rule: For each season in 2021-2024, one row per source team, carrying that season's subdivision and conference verbatim.
derivation.caret_handling: The source marks lower-confidence affiliations with a caret. The caret is stripped from the division and conference values and recorded separately in source_confidence_marker, so the marker is preserved rather than discarded. Zero rows in the 2021-2024 window carry one.
derivation.ordering: Sorted by (season, team_key). Deterministic and stable across regeneration.
derivation.encoding: UTF-8, LF line endings, header row, no trailing blank line.

open_lineage.declared_by: Methodology sheet of the source workbook
open_lineage.consequence: The chain is documented and cannot be closed to bytes here. That is why the source is registered POPULATION_CANDIDATE_LINEAGE_OPEN and is not mounted.

conflicting_statement.note: The two disagree about membership, not merely about rating eligibility. Neither is subordinate to the other, so 2024 resolves to UNRESOLVED_CONFLICTING_CANDIDATES.

non_2026_scope_note: Division here is the division of the season being reconstructed. The synthetic 2026 canonical master is identity metadata only; it classifies real FBS programs as schedule-only FCS and real FCS programs as FBS members, and neither statement is used as a historical division.
